description: Make a new collab.demo room and get its links (send `link` to the people you work with; keep `host_link` yourself). Start from a template (pair-build, standup), from your own words (turned into a typed routine and schema-checked; it is never run as code), or from a routine JSON (see https://ce-net.com/collab/modules for the module types).

routine.description: a routine object: {id, title, description, modules: [module ids], roles: [{name, rights: [chat|edit|draw|cursor|voice|host], default?}], steps: [{title, module?, minutes?, note?}], limits?: {max_participants, ttl_hours}}

words.description: describe the routine in plain words (1000 characters)

name: collab_routine_create
